items.statement: A harness whose role contains a hyphen (ci-check) gets through the Setup agent environment step instead of failing with 'not a valid identifier'.
Role-prefixed identifiers map the role with role.upper().replace("-", "_") through one shared helper.
Every downstream consumer of role-prefixed identifiers uses the same mapping to look them up.

items.description: setup-agent-env.sh is the one consumer named in the issue Context section with no test. It looks up role-prefixed repo variables (<ROLE>_FULLSEND_MODEL) off AGENT_PREFIX, and this PR changes only its header comment (+3/-1, no code). No test asserts that a CI_CHECK_FULLSEND_MODEL repo variable is resolved for role ci-check; the fix is inherited transitively from the workflow's AGENT_PREFIX and is untested at that boundary.
items.remediation: Add a test that runs setup-agent-env.sh with AGENT_PREFIX=CI_CHECK_ and a FULLSEND_REPO_VARS map containing CI_CHECK_FULLSEND_MODEL, asserting the role-prefixed override is exported and wins over the plain FULLSEND_MODEL.
items.evidence: diff: internal/scaffold/fullsend-repo/.github/scripts/setup-agent-env.sh changes comment lines only; no test file in the PR references setup-agent-env.sh.

items.description: The embedded mint copy internal/dispatch/gcf/mintsrc/mintcore/patterns.go.embed gains RoleIdentifier (+11 lines) and foreign.go.embed starts calling it, but no test in this PR touches the .embed copies; TestRoleIdentifier was added only for internal/mintcore. Static reachability only: the added embed lines are not executed by anything in the diff.
items.remediation: Confirm the existing embed/source drift check enumerates patterns.go.embed; if it does not, extend it so the GCF copy cannot diverge from internal/mintcore/patterns.go.
items.evidence: diff adds identical RoleIdentifier bodies to internal/mintcore/patterns.go and internal/dispatch/gcf/mintsrc/mintcore/patterns.go.embed; only internal/mintcore/patterns_test.go is added.

items.description: parseForeignVariableName has more than one call site, but only runGitHubStatus was corrected to stop printing the lossily reconstructed role (CI_CHECK parses back to ci_check, never ci-check). internal/cli/foreign.go is touched in this PR for help text only, so any role rendering in its list/deny output would still show a role the user never typed. Not verifiable from the diff alone.
items.remediation: Grep every parseForeignVariableName caller and apply the same name-only rendering; mirror the NotContains("(ci-check)") assertion from TestRunGitHubStatus_ForeignVariableOmitsParsedRole in the foreign-list test.
items.evidence: internal/cli/github.go drops the parsed role from the printed line; internal/cli/foreign.go's diff is limited to the cobra Long string.

items.description: The identifier collision this mapping introduces (ci-check and ci_check both map to CI_CHECK, so they share FULLSEND_CI_CHECK_APP_PRIVATE_KEY and the FOREIGN allow-list variable) is documented in standalone-mint.md and pinned at the helper level, but nothing detects or rejects two colliding roles at registration: one role silently overwrites the other's credential. Out of scope for #7140, raised because this PR is what creates the collision.
items.remediation: Decide whether role registration / ValidateRoleName should reject a role whose RoleIdentifier already exists, then add a test for that rejection. Needs a product decision before a code agent can act.
items.evidence: internal/mintcore/patterns_test.go pins {"my-role","MY_ROLE"} and {"my_role","MY_ROLE"}; no test or code guards the resulting credential-name collision.
